title_en: Why nobody sits in this empty seat 🩷 #shorts
description_en:
Every Seoul subway car has pink seats for pregnant women. Even when the train is packed, most people leave them empty — some stand rather than sit there. It's called baeryeoseok, a care seat. And the rule is simple: because someone might need it more.

Stock footage: Pexels (free license) · Illustrations: original
hook_sub_en: Because someone might need it more.
hook_vi: Vì có thể có người cần chỗ đó hơn.
hook_id: Karena mungkin ada yang lebih membutuhkannya.
hook_es: Porque puede que alguien más lo necesite.
hook_ar: لأنّ أحدًا قد يحتاجه أكثر منّي.
hook_fil: Kasi baka may mas kailangan nito.
hook_hi: क्योंकि किसी को इसकी ज़्यादा ज़रूरत हो सकती है।
hook_ja: もっと必要とする人がいるかもしれないから。

hook_voice_parts.text: Because someone might need it more.

scenes.sub_en: My first week in Seoul, I almost sat in a pink seat.
scenes.sub_vi: Tuần đầu ở Seoul, tôi suýt ngồi vào ghế màu hồng.
scenes.sub_id: Pekan pertama di Seoul, hampir saja aku duduk di kursi merah muda.
scenes.sub_es: Mi primera semana en Seúl casi me senté en un asiento rosa.
scenes.sub_pt: Na minha primeira semana em Seul, quase sentei num assento rosa.
scenes.sub_ar: في أسبوعي الأول في سيول، كدت أجلس على مقعد وردي.
scenes.sub_fil: Unang linggo ko sa Seoul, muntik na akong umupo sa pink na upuan.
scenes.sub_hi: सियोल में मेरे पहले हफ़्ते, मैं गुलाबी सीट पर लगभग बैठ ही गया था।

voice_parts.text: My first week in Seoul, I almost sat in a pink seat.

scenes.sub_en: It's called baeryeoseok, a care seat for pregnant women.
scenes.sub_vi: Người Hàn gọi đó là "baeryeoseok" — ghế dành cho phụ nữ mang thai.
scenes.sub_es: Se llama «baeryeoseok»: el asiento para embarazadas.
scenes.sub_fil: Tinatawag itong "baeryeoseok", upuan para sa mga buntis.
scenes.sub_hi: इसे "बेरयोसॉक" कहते हैं — गर्भवती महिलाओं के लिए सीट।

voice_parts.text: It's called baeryeoseok, a care seat for pregnant women.

scenes.en: No one pregnant. Still nobody sat.
scenes.sub_en: No one was pregnant. The train was packed. Still, nobody sat. Not even me.
scenes.sub_vi: Không có ai mang thai. Tàu thì đông. Vậy mà không ai ngồi. Cả tôi cũng không.
scenes.sub_id: Tidak ada yang hamil. Kereta penuh. Tetap tak ada yang duduk. Aku pun tidak.
scenes.sub_es: No había ninguna embarazada. El tren iba lleno. Aun así, nadie se sentó. Ni yo.
scenes.sub_pt: Não havia nenhuma gestante. O trem estava cheio. Mesmo assim, ninguém sentou. Nem eu.
scenes.sub_ar: لم تكن هناك حامل. والقطار كان مزدحمًا. ومع ذلك لم يجلس أحد. ولا أنا.
scenes.sub_fil: Walang buntis. Puno ang tren. Pero walang umupo. Kahit ako.
scenes.sub_hi: कोई गर्भवती नहीं थी। ट्रेन भरी थी। फिर भी कोई नहीं बैठा। मैं भी नहीं।

voice_parts.text: No one was pregnant. The train was packed. Still, nobody sat. Not even me.

cta.en: In Korea — so why does nobody sit?
cta.sub_vi: Vậy tại sao không ai ngồi?
cta.sub_id: Jadi kenapa tak ada yang duduk?
